prompts.meta_prompt: Create a natural language text description for an image that contains the following elements with specified colors: {'object': 'bicycle', 'color': 'red'}, {'object': 'chair', 'color': 'white'}, {'object': 'broccoli', 'color': 'green'}, {'object': 'cat', 'color': 'gray'}. Include a person showing sadness. Output ONLY prompt, no comment, no explanations.
synthetic_prompts: A street-side scene: a bright red bicycle leans against a weathered white chair, and a small printed sign attached to the chair reads "White chair, red bicycle: please do not move". A reusable grocery bag sits nearby with a head of vibrant green broccoli poking out, and a plump gray cat is curled on the chair seat, tail wrapped around its paws. Three people populate the scene — a woman near the bicycle clutching her chest and trembling in obvious fear, a teenager with wide eyes and hands thrown up showing surprise, and an older man seated on the curb with bowed shoulders and tears on his face, clearly sad.

Three people react dramatically: a woman near the door freezes in fear, clutching her coat; a young man by the window gasps in surprise, hands raised to his mouth; and an older woman on the sofa bows her head, tears tracing her cheeks in sorrow.
